subject.title: I.5.1, printed p. 67: global Euler characteristic formula
Footnote 13: normalized real and complex absolute values

note: For finite l-primary coefficients M with #M=m, the source uses ordinary H0 at infinite places, not modified Tate H0. At a complex place the numerator is m and the normalized absolute value is m^2; at a real place the denominator is m and the numerator is the fixed subgroup of complex conjugation. Thus the product is archH0Card/m^[F:Q], and clearing the denominator and #H1 gives exactly GlobalEulerCharAt. Lean quantifies over a finite S containing all places above l, continuous action on a discrete finite Z/l^r-module with r>0, and choices of complex conjugation at real places; GlobalEulerChar wraps that predicate. The book covers a broader setting. No independently elaborated comparison or fresh compiled dependency graph is claimed. This work was assisted by ChatGPT.
